metric.implemented: computed end to end; every field is have or derived
metric.defined: definition fixed; every field is have or derived; no computation yet
metric.needs_fields: definition fixed; at least one field is add or unavailable, so the number is not available

field.have: written by the current recorder (source v2) or the compact record
field.derived: computed reliably from fields that are have
field.add: planned F1 field of a later round; absent from every source today
field.unavailable: not visible to the player or not part of any upload; the metric stays unavailable

records.title: Rules of every metric over game records, computed by one view of GET /stats/v2/analytics/records/<view> (task contract K3, ADR 0014)
records.unit: one record of one installation: a game, or one finished Arena run (an arena_run record); two installations in one lobby are two observations
records.patches: server/pool/data/balance-patches.json lists the balance patches of each line as {id, fromBuild, fromDay}; a build belongs to the entry with the greatest fromBuild not above it; a record without build, or with a build below the first entry, is unknown; the builds of one balance patch are one group and two balance patches are never merged
records.today: T, the server's day (days since 1970, UTC); a record dated after T waits for its day

windows.days: every record of the patch that is read
day in [T - 6, T], inside the patch
day in [T - 29, T], inside the patch
every record of the patch that is read

records.thresholdRule: a slice (one patch, window and query of a view) whose records come from fewer than minInstalls distinct installations (iid) publishes nothing: its totals (games or runs, installs) and suppressed, where the view's data has them, are null, it has no rows and its quality is small_sample, the same answer as a slice nobody played; in a published slice a row needs minInstalls installations among the records it is made of, else it is not listed and counts in suppressed where the view's data has one (task contract K5: constructed-classes, constructed-cards, constructed-choices and bg-tierups have none, and a row under the threshold is just absent); each number needs minInstalls installations among the records of its own denominator, else null; with fewer than minGames in its denominator it keeps its counts (num, den, n) but value, interval and dist are null; a deck list needs minDeckGames games; a row with a null value is small_sample, otherwise ok; nothing is padded or borrowed from another slice, window or patch

intervals.mean: mean +/- 1.96 s / sqrt(n), s the sample standard deviation; null when n < 2
intervals.placement: the mean place with its interval, and dist: the count of each place 1..8 (Duos 1..4)

rankable.never: means of turns and of seconds
rankable.order: each metric names the number its rows are ordered by; only rows whose number is rankable are ordered, the rest are listed below them by games and never mixed into the order

records.withdrawal: a forget (POST /v1/events/forget) or the 180-day clean-up that deleted records withdraws every record view in the same transaction: available false, reason rebuilding, until the next build, which no longer holds them; a maintenance pass that deleted nothing withdraws nothing; the app keeps an answer at most 6 hours, shows no older copy while the pool is down and deletes a copy dated in the future
records.display: labelled Hearthpulse statistics, beside the external Hearthpulse data and never mixed with them or filled from them, always with games, installations, interval, window and patch; the main window always, with honest empty states; the overlay only where a value exists, and only for the player's own deck, offers and picks

metrics.unit: one BG solo game capture (one installation's observation); window start.day in [today - 30, today]
metrics.numerator: picked(h): captures fit for offers whose pick is h; placement: places of captures fit for offers and outcome whose pick is h
metrics.denominator: offered(h): captures fit for offers whose offer contains h (once per capture); placement.n(h): captures fit for offers and outcome whose pick is h

Above that, a value with fewer than ANALYTICS_MIN_CELL (10) games in its denominator keeps num/den (n) but value/low/high (mean) and dist are null; a row with any null value is small_sample (docs/analytics-api.md)
metrics.statistics: pickRate = picked / offered and top4/first: Wilson interval, z = 1.96; mean place: mean +/- 1.96 s / sqrt(n), null when n < 2; dist[0..7] counts places 1..8

metrics.title: Offered, kept, replaced and received after the mulligan, and the game result
metrics.unit: one card instance in an opening hand
metrics.numerator: instances kept (keep rate); games won with the card kept (win rate when kept)
metrics.denominator: instances offered; games where the card was kept
metrics.missing: the opening hand and the hand after the swap are different facts; an unclear card move is not a confirmed swap
metrics.smallSample: every number needs at least 5 installations (owner) among its own observations, else null; value null below 10 games
metrics.display: no screen: the mulligan guide comes from mulligan.card over game records, the main path (mainPath, ADR 0014)

metrics.title: Win rate of two cards offered together in the opening hand, by which of them were kept (an observed association, not a causal effect)
metrics.unit: one compact game record of one installation (table e, docs/game-stats.md): Ranked, Standard or Wild, with a class, a result W or L and a mulligan; window record.day in [today - 30, today]
metrics.numerator: per pair of different cards (a < b) offered together in one opening hand, per keep cell (both kept, only a kept, only b kept, neither kept): records of the cell with record.res = W
metrics.denominator: records of the cell; the pair's own cell is both kept: the games where both cards were kept in the opening hand
metrics.missing: a record without a class, a mulligan or a win/loss result (a tie included) is left out of every cell; a record dated after today (a clock running ahead is accepted for one day) waits until its day; a card offered twice counts once and two copies of one card are not a pair; a card kept while the other was not on offer is in no cell of that pair; mull-pairs-1 does not read the game build (records carried none before TASK-2026-11-26-pro-collection), so the 30-day window is the only bound on patch mix and builds are not told apart
metrics.smallSample: a pair is listed only when its both-kept cell holds 200 games (MIN_PAIR_GAMES) of at least 5 installations (distinct iid), else it is absent, never padded; each comparison cell (only a, only b, neither) is null under 5 installations or under 10 games (MIN_CELL); at most 200 pairs a group, most played first. The app shows a value only with all four cells, 30 games in each comparison cell and a nominal interval of the difference that excludes zero
metrics.statistics: pair difference = p(both) - p(only a) - p(only b) + p(neither): an observed association between keeping both and the result, not a causal effect of keeping them. The four cells are disjoint games, so the nominal 95% interval of the difference is +/- 1.96 * sqrt(sum of p(1-p)/n over the cells), each share smoothed by one win and one loss; a pair is shown only when that interval excludes zero and the difference is at least 1.5 points. The interval is nominal and too narrow: repeated games of one installation count as independent (only counts are published; installs is published beside them), the 30-day window mixes patches, the cells are selected by the players' own keep decisions, and many pairs are looked at with no correction. The app shows the difference as an observation and does not use it in the keep/replace call or in the estimate of the hand
metrics.withdrawal: POST /v1/events/forget and the clean-up delete the published table in the same batch as the records and raise the deletion fence (snap row events-rev); a build publishes only if the fence did not move since it started reading, otherwise it counts again. The app keeps an answer at most 6 hours, keeps no older copy for the time the pool is down, and drops pairs in memory when the pool stops publishing them or its address changes
metrics.display: M1: mulligan panel of both apps - a flag on both cards, and in the card tooltip and the summary details the observed difference with its approximate interval, the games with both kept, the label Hearthpulse statistics and the note that the advice does not count it

metrics.title: Mulligan guide per card: kept rate, win rate in the opening hand, when drawn and when played, turns held, turn played, and their deviation from the slice
metrics.unit: one Ranked Standard or Wild game record of one installation with a class and a mulligan; kept and turnsHeld count the copies of a card one by one, the win rates and turnPlayed count games
metrics.numerator: kept: offered copies of the card that were kept; opening, drawn, played: games won (res W) in which the card was in the hand after the mulligan (kept or received) / a copy from the deck came into the hand at any time, the opening hand included / a copy from the deck was played; turnsHeld: the sum over played deck copies of the play turn minus the turn the copy came into the hand (the opening hand is turn 0); turnPlayed: the sum of the turn of the card's first play; base: games won
metrics.denominator: kept: copies of the card offered in opening hands (two copies in one hand are two offers; a game counts at most as many kept copies as it offered); opening, drawn, played: the games of the numerator's kind with res W or L; turnsHeld: played deck copies with a known arrival; turnPlayed: games in which a deck copy was played; base: the slice's games with res W or L; delta: opening, drawn and played minus base.value
metrics.missing: a record without a class, a mulligan or a W/L result is left out of the card numbers (a tie counts in games only); the slice is the class or the server's archetype of the deck (derived.archetype), and a deck it does not recognise is in the class slice only; created cards (created = 1 in draws and plays) are never deck copies; drawn, played, turnsHeld and turnPlayed need a readable deck code (without the list nothing is marked created); copies are matched first in, first out: the n-th play of a card is the n-th copy that came into the hand, opening-hand copies first, and a play without a matching arrival (lists cut at the server's limits) counts in played and turnPlayed but not in turnsHeld; a deck copy is an approximation, a card whose id is in the deck list (created = 0) rather than a tracked card: a copy of a listed card that an effect generated counts as a deck copy, a listed card whose id changed in the hand (Corrupt or Infuse, for example) is played as created and leaves its card's played and turnPlayed, and an arrival is any entry into the hand, so a listed card returned to the hand from the board counts in drawn and a card traded into the deck and drawn again arrives twice; drawn, played, turnsHeld and turnPlayed are therefore approximate, turnsHeld can count turns a copy spent in the deck or on the board, and an exact count needs a new record field and a new rules version; turns are the player's own (game turns 2N-1 and 2N are turn N); the Coin is not a mulligan card; no slice by opponent class (eleven times the volume, a later rules version)
metrics.smallSample: a card is listed from 5 installations among the games in which it was offered, came into the hand or was played (else it counts in suppressed); each number needs 5 installations among the records of its own denominator, else null: kept among the games that offered the card, opening, drawn and played among their games, turnsHeld and turnPlayed among the games in which a deck copy was played, base among the slice; above that, a value with fewer than 10 in its denominator (copies for kept and turnsHeld, games for the rest) keeps its counts but value and interval are null; a delta is null when either side is; a slice under 5 installations publishes nothing (records.thresholdRule)
metrics.statistics: kept, opening, drawn, played and base: Wilson interval, z = 1.96 (kept is nominal: two copies in one hand are not independent); turnsHeld and turnPlayed: mean +/- 1.96 s / sqrt(n), null when n < 2; delta = value - base.value with no interval of its own: an observed difference from the slice's win rate, not the effect of keeping, drawing or playing the card
metrics.rankable: cards are ordered by opening (the mulligan win rate) among the cards whose opening is rankable (half-width at most 5 points); the rest are listed below them by games; turnsHeld and turnPlayed are never rankable
metrics.withdrawal: as every record view (records.withdrawal): a forget or a clean-up that deleted records withdraws it in the same transaction
metrics.display: U1: the archetype card of the Constructed meta page, a Hearthpulse statistics block beside the external guide; U2: the overlay's mulligan card tooltip and summary, only for cards with a value. Neither changes the keep/replace call or the estimate of the hand

metrics.title: Archetype tier list: win rate, share in its class and among all games, win rate going first and with the Coin
metrics.unit: one Ranked Standard or Wild game record of one installation with a class
metrics.numerator: winrate: games of the archetype won; shareClass and shareAll: games of the archetype; first / coin: games of the archetype won going first / with the Coin
metrics.denominator: winrate: games of the archetype with res W or L; shareClass: games of its class; shareAll: all games of the slice; first / coin: games of the archetype with res W or L going first (first = true) / with the Coin (first = false)
metrics.missing: the archetype is the server's (derived.archetype), never the name the client sent; a deck it does not recognise, or a game without a readable deck code, is its class's row with arch null; a record without a class is left out; a tie counts in games and shares, not in win rates; a game without first counts in winrate and the shares only
metrics.smallSample: a row is listed from 5 installations among its games (else it counts in suppressed); each number needs 5 installations among the games of its own denominator, else null (first: the row's games going first, coin: with the Coin); a value with fewer than 10 games in its denominator keeps num/den but value and interval are null; a slice under 5 installations publishes nothing (records.thresholdRule)
metrics.statistics: winrate, shareClass, shareAll, first and coin: Wilson interval, z = 1.96, over games (a heavy player's games weigh more; installs is published beside them)
metrics.rankable: rows are ordered by winrate among the rows whose winrate is rankable (half-width at most 5 points); the rest are listed below them by games; the order is not a test that one archetype beats another
metrics.withdrawal: as every record view (records.withdrawal): a forget or a clean-up that deleted records withdraws it in the same transaction
metrics.display: U1: the Constructed meta page, a Hearthpulse statistics tier list beside the external one

metrics.title: Classes: win rate, share of games, win rate going first and with the Coin
metrics.unit: one Ranked Standard or Wild game record of one installation with a class
metrics.numerator: winrate: games of the class won; share: games of the class; first / coin: games of the class won going first / with the Coin
metrics.denominator: winrate: games of the class with res W or L; share: all games of the slice; first / coin: games of the class with res W or L going first / with the Coin
metrics.missing: a record without a class is left out; a tie counts in games and share, not in win rates; a game without first counts in winrate and share only
metrics.smallSample: a class is listed from 5 installations among its games (the view has no suppressed count, task contract K5: a class under it is just absent); each number needs 5 installations among the games of its own denominator, else null; a value with fewer than 10 games in its denominator keeps num/den but value and interval are null; a slice under 5 installations publishes nothing (records.thresholdRule)
metrics.statistics: winrate, share, first and coin: Wilson interval, z = 1.96
metrics.rankable: classes are ordered by winrate among the classes whose winrate is rankable (half-width at most 5 points); the rest are listed below them by games
metrics.withdrawal: as every record view (records.withdrawal): a forget or a clean-up that deleted records withdraws it in the same transaction
metrics.display: U1: the Constructed meta page, a Hearthpulse statistics class block

metrics.title: Matchups: win rate of an archetype or class against another, from the recording player's side
metrics.unit: one Ranked Standard or Wild game record of one installation with its class and the opponent's class, seen from the recording player's side
metrics.numerator: games of a against b won
metrics.denominator: games of a against b with res W or L
metrics.missing: by class: a is record.cls and b record.ocls, and a record without either is left out; by archetype: a is the server's archetype of the player's deck and b the opponent's (derived.opponentArchetype, from the cards the opponent showed and its class), and a game in which either is unknown is in the class matrix only; the client's oarch is never used; a against b and b against a are different cells from different players' records and need not add up to 100%; a mirror is counted once, from the recording side; a tie counts in games, not in the win rate
metrics.smallSample: a cell is listed from 5 installations among its games (else it counts in suppressed); its winrate needs 5 installations among the games of its own denominator (the cell's games with res W or L), else null; a winrate with fewer than 10 games in its denominator keeps num/den but value and interval are null; a slice under 5 installations publishes nothing (records.thresholdRule)
metrics.statistics: winrate: Wilson interval, z = 1.96, per cell; with many cells some look extreme by chance, and each cell is its own estimate
metrics.rankable: a matrix, not a ranking: rankable marks the cells whose half-width is at most 5 points, precise enough to compare; the matrix is not ordered by win rate
metrics.withdrawal: as every record view (records.withdrawal): a forget or a clean-up that deleted records withdraws it in the same transaction
metrics.display: U1: the Constructed meta page, a Hearthpulse statistics matchup block (archetype by archetype and class by class); the opponent's archetype appears only here, as an aggregate, never during a game

metrics.title: Popular deck lists: canonical code, win rate, length in seconds and turns, win rate against each class
metrics.unit: one Ranked Standard or Wild game record of one installation with a class and a readable deck code
metrics.numerator: winrate: games of the list won; secs, turns: the sum of game length in seconds / in player turns; vsClass[C]: games of the list against class C won
metrics.denominator: winrate: games of the list with res W or L; secs, turns: games of the list; vsClass[C]: games of the list against C with res W or L
metrics.missing: a list is its deck key (derived.deckKey): two codes of one list, in another card order, with another hero skin or format, are one row, and the sideboard is not part of it; the published code is canonical, re-encoded from the list with the class's default hero (a rare hero skin could single a player out), never a code as a player sent it and never a deck name; a game without a readable deck code is left out; a tie counts in games, secs and turns, not in win rates; a game without the opponent's class is in no vsClass cell
metrics.smallSample: a list is published only from 50 games (records.thresholds.minDeckGames; the view's data repeats it as minGames) of at least 5 installations (Q5), else it is not listed and counts in suppressed; each number needs 5 installations among the games of its own denominator, else null; a value with fewer than 10 games in its denominator keeps its counts but value and interval are null (each vsClass cell by its own games); a slice under 5 installations publishes nothing (records.thresholdRule)
metrics.statistics: winrate and vsClass: Wilson interval, z = 1.96; secs and turns: mean +/- 1.96 s / sqrt(n), null when n < 2 (right-skewed: a few long games pull the mean)
metrics.rankable: lists are ordered by winrate among the lists whose winrate is rankable (half-width at most 5 points); the rest are listed below them by games; secs and turns are never rankable
metrics.withdrawal: as every record view (records.withdrawal): a forget or a clean-up that deleted records withdraws it in the same transaction
metrics.display: U1: the Constructed meta page, a Hearthpulse statistics block of popular lists with their canonical codes

metrics.title: Cards of a class: share of decks holding the card, their win rate, how often it is played and the win rate when played
metrics.unit: one Ranked Standard or Wild game record of one installation with a class and a readable deck code
metrics.numerator: decks: games whose deck list holds the card; deckWinrate: of those, games won; played: of those, games in which a deck copy was played; playedWinrate: games won in which a deck copy was played
metrics.denominator: decks: the class's games with a readable deck code; deckWinrate: games whose list holds the card, with res W or L; played: games whose list holds the card; playedWinrate: games in which a deck copy was played, with res W or L
metrics.missing: a game without a readable deck code is left out: without the list a played card cannot be told from a created one; created cards (created = 1) are never deck copies; a deck copy is a play whose card id is in the list (created = 0) rather than a tracked card, so a copy of a listed card that an effect generated counts in played and a listed card whose id changed in the hand (Corrupt or Infuse, for example) does not: played and playedWinrate are approximate; the shares are of games, not of distinct lists, so a list played more weighs more; dbf comes from the server's card map (B1); a tie counts in decks and played, not in win rates
metrics.smallSample: a card is listed from 5 installations among the games whose list holds it (the view has no suppressed count, task contract K5: a card under it is just absent); each number needs 5 installations among the games of its own denominator, else null; a value with fewer than 10 games in its denominator keeps num/den but value and interval are null; a slice under 5 installations publishes nothing (records.thresholdRule)
metrics.statistics: decks, deckWinrate, played and playedWinrate: Wilson interval, z = 1.96; the win rates describe the games, not the card's effect (a card played when ahead wins more)
metrics.rankable: cards are ordered by decks (how many decks hold it) among the cards whose decks share is rankable (half-width at most 5 points); the rest are listed below them by games
metrics.withdrawal: as every record view (records.withdrawal): a forget or a clean-up that deleted records withdraws it in the same transaction
metrics.display: U5: the card page, a Hearthpulse statistics block

metrics.title: Choices from a source card (Discover and the like): how often each option is offered and picked, and the win rate when picked
metrics.unit: one resolved choice in a Ranked Standard or Wild game record of one installation (a source card showed 2 to 8 options and the player picked); the win rate counts games
metrics.numerator: picked: choices of the source in which the option was picked; winrate: games won in which the option was picked from the source
metrics.denominator: picked: offered, the choices of the source whose options hold the option (once per choice); winrate: games in which the option was picked from the source, with res W or L (a game counts once)
metrics.missing: a choice without a source card is not counted, whatever its kind: it has no group; the kind is the client's, from the source card's mechanics; options are as the player saw them, and an option shown twice in one choice counts once; a record holds the player's own choices only; a tie counts in offered and picked, not in the win rate
metrics.smallSample: a source is listed from 5 installations among its choices, an option from 5 installations among the choices that offered it (the view has no suppressed count, task contract K5: a source or option under it is just absent); each number needs 5 installations among the records of its own denominator, else null; a value with fewer than 10 in its denominator (choices for picked, games for winrate) keeps num/den but value and interval are null; a slice under 5 installations publishes nothing (records.thresholdRule)
metrics.statistics: picked and winrate: Wilson interval, z = 1.96; the win rate when picked is an association: the pick depends on the game the player is in
metrics.rankable: the options of a source are ordered by picked among the options whose picked is rankable (half-width at most 5 points); the rest are listed below them by offers
metrics.withdrawal: as every record view (records.withdrawal): a forget or a clean-up that deleted records withdraws it in the same transaction
metrics.display: U2: the overlay's choice hint, rows only for options with a value

metrics.title: Battlegrounds heroes from game records: offered, picked, place after the pick, top and first places, by mode and MMR range
metrics.unit: one Battlegrounds game record of one installation; solo and Duos are never mixed
metrics.numerator: pick: games whose offer holds h and whose pick is h; placement: the places of the games whose pick is h (dist counts places 1..8, Duos 1..4); top: of those, games in the top 4 (Duos: top 2); first: of those, games in first place
metrics.denominator: pick: offered, the games whose offer holds h; placement, top and first: the games whose pick is h
metrics.missing: the offer is the record's: up to four heroes seen at the pick, rerolled ones appended and cut at four, always with the pick; a record whose pick is past those four (its offer is empty) or a game recovered after a restart counts only in the place numbers of its pick; unlike bg.hero.offer_pick_placement (the offer at the moment of the pick), a hero rerolled away early is in offered; a Duos record with a place above 4 is not counted; a record without mmr is in the all range only
metrics.smallSample: a hero is listed from 5 installations among the games it was offered or picked in (else it counts in suppressed); each number needs 5 installations among the games of its own denominator, else null: pick among the games that offered it, placement, top and first among the games that picked it; above that, a value with fewer than 10 games in its denominator keeps num/den (n) but value, interval and dist are null; a slice under 5 installations publishes nothing (records.thresholdRule); the floor of the pick share differs between the two paths: here pick needs 5 installations that were offered the hero, in bg-hero-1 (bg.hero.offer_pick_placement) picked and pickRate need 5 installations that picked it, so a cross-check of the paths compares only heroes with a value on both: a value on one side and null on the other is a difference of floors, not of numbers
metrics.statistics: pick, top and first: Wilson interval, z = 1.96; placement: mean +/- 1.96 s / sqrt(n), null when n < 2, with the distribution of places
metrics.rankable: heroes are ordered by placement (lower first) among the heroes whose placement is rankable (half-width at most 0.3 places); the rest are listed below them by games
metrics.withdrawal: as every record view (records.withdrawal): a forget or a clean-up that deleted records withdraws it in the same transaction
metrics.display: U3: the Heroes tab of the Battlegrounds page; the own block moves here from the capture snapshot (bg.hero.offer_pick_placement stays on the server as a cross-check), with mode and MMR range

metrics.title: Battlegrounds trinkets from game records: offered, picked, place after the pick and top places, by mode and MMR range
metrics.unit: one Battlegrounds game record of one installation with its trinkets; solo and Duos are never mixed
metrics.numerator: pick: games whose picks hold t; placement: the places of the games that picked t (dist as for heroes); top: of those, games in the top 4 (Duos: top 2)
metrics.denominator: pick: offered, the games whose trinket offers hold t; placement and top: the games that picked t
metrics.missing: a record keeps every trinket offered in the game as one list (both offers, picks included, at most 12) and the picks as another (at most 4): the lesser and the greater offer cannot be told apart, and a trinket offered twice in a game counts once; a game without trinkets counts nowhere; a Duos record with a place above 4 is not counted; a record without mmr is in the all range only
metrics.smallSample: a trinket is listed from 5 installations among the games it was offered in (else it counts in suppressed); each number needs 5 installations among the games of its own denominator, else null: pick among the games that offered it, placement and top among the games that picked it; above that, a value with fewer than 10 games in its denominator keeps num/den (n) but value, interval and dist are null; a slice under 5 installations publishes nothing (records.thresholdRule)
metrics.statistics: pick and top: Wilson interval, z = 1.96; placement: mean +/- 1.96 s / sqrt(n), null when n < 2, with the distribution of places
metrics.rankable: trinkets are ordered by placement (lower first) among the trinkets whose placement is rankable (half-width at most 0.3 places); the rest are listed below them by games
metrics.withdrawal: as every record view (records.withdrawal): a forget or a clean-up that deleted records withdraws it in the same transaction
metrics.display: U3: the Trinkets tab of the Battlegrounds page, a Hearthpulse statistics block

metrics.title: Battlegrounds final comps from game records: share of games, place, top and first places, by mode and MMR range
metrics.unit: one Battlegrounds game record of one installation with the main tribe of its final board; solo and Duos are never mixed
metrics.numerator: share: games whose comp is c; placement: the places of those games (dist as for heroes); top: of those, games in the top 4 (Duos: top 2); first: of those, games in first place
metrics.denominator: share: the slice's games with a comp; placement, top and first: the games whose comp is c
metrics.missing: the comp is bg.comp, the main tribe of the final board (a tribe of at least 4 minions, amalgams counting for every tribe, else MIXED), sent from the app version with A1; a game without it (an older app, an empty board, a game recovered after a restart) counts nowhere; the final board is what the player ended with, so the numbers are an association between ending with a comp and the place, not the comp's effect, and a player knocked out early had less time to build; a Duos record with a place above 4 is not counted
metrics.smallSample: a comp is listed from 5 installations among its games (else it counts in suppressed); each number needs 5 installations among the games of its own denominator, else null; a value with fewer than 10 games in its denominator keeps num/den (n) but value, interval and dist are null; a slice under 5 installations publishes nothing (records.thresholdRule)
metrics.statistics: share, top and first: Wilson interval, z = 1.96; placement: mean +/- 1.96 s / sqrt(n), null when n < 2, with the distribution of places
metrics.rankable: comps are ordered by placement (lower first) among the comps whose placement is rankable (half-width at most 0.3 places); the rest are listed below them by games
metrics.withdrawal: as every record view (records.withdrawal): a forget or a clean-up that deleted records withdraws it in the same transaction
metrics.display: U3: the Comps tab of the Battlegrounds page, a Hearthpulse statistics block

metrics.title: Battlegrounds tavern tier-ups from game records: the turn each tier was reached and the place of the games that reached it
metrics.unit: one Battlegrounds game record of one installation that reached tavern tier t (2 to 7); solo and Duos are never mixed
metrics.numerator: turn: the sum of the first turn on which the tavern reached tier t; placement: the sum of the places of those games
metrics.denominator: the games that reached tier t
metrics.missing: bg.tierups holds the first turn of each tier the tavern reached; a game that never reached tier t is not in its row, so the rows are different sets of games (players knocked out early reach fewer tiers) and are not compared as one population; a game without tierups (recovered after a restart) counts nowhere; a Duos record with a place above 4 is not counted
metrics.smallSample: a tier is listed from 5 installations among the games that reached it (the view has no suppressed count, task contract K5: a tier under it is just absent); turn and placement need 5 installations among the games of their own denominator (the games that reached the tier), else null; with fewer than 10 of those games n stays but mean and interval are null; a slice under 5 installations publishes nothing (records.thresholdRule)
metrics.statistics: turn and placement: mean +/- 1.96 s / sqrt(n), null when n < 2
metrics.rankable: rows are the tiers in order, not a ranking: turn is never rankable; placement is rankable at a half-width of at most 0.3 places
metrics.withdrawal: as every record view (records.withdrawal): a forget or a clean-up that deleted records withdraws it in the same transaction
metrics.display: U3: the Battlegrounds page, the timings block

metrics.title: Arena classes by finished runs: share of runs, mean wins, runs with 7 or more wins, win rate of their games
metrics.unit: one finished Arena run of one installation (an arena_run record: 12 wins or the loss limit)
metrics.numerator: share: runs of the class; seven: runs of the class with at least 7 wins; winrate: the wins of the class's runs; wins: the sum of their wins
metrics.denominator: share: the runs of the slice (one Arena kind); seven and wins: the runs of the class; winrate: the wins plus losses of the class's runs
metrics.missing: a run is sent once, when its last game ends it (12 wins, or 3 losses in Arena and 5 in Underground), only when one of its games has a deck id and none was brought over from another tracker; old runs are not sent; known bias: an app that starts in the middle of a run has only its later games, so that run's wins are understated, and a run retired before its end is never sent; Arena and Underground are never mixed (kind); the patch is the build of the run's last game
metrics.smallSample: a class is listed from 5 installations among its runs (else it counts in suppressed); each number needs 5 installations among the runs of its own denominator, else null; a value with fewer than 10 in its denominator (runs; games for winrate) keeps its counts but value and interval are null; a slice under 5 installations publishes nothing (records.thresholdRule)
metrics.statistics: share and seven: Wilson interval over runs, z = 1.96; winrate: Wilson interval over games, nominal and too narrow (the games of one run are not independent); wins: mean +/- 1.96 s / sqrt(n), null when n < 2
metrics.rankable: classes are ordered by wins among the classes whose wins is rankable (half-width at most 0.3 wins); the rest are listed below them by runs
metrics.withdrawal: as every record view (records.withdrawal): a forget or a clean-up that deleted records withdraws it in the same transaction
metrics.display: U4: My Stats, Arena, a Hearthpulse statistics block beside the external class numbers

compact game record v1, column mode (docs/game-stats.md); arena_run for the summary of a finished Arena run (task contract K1)

compact game record v1, mull.k: the offered cards that were kept

compact record build: the game's build (GameState.BuildNumber, 1..99,999,999), sent from the app version with TASK-2026-11-26-pro-collection A1 (arena_run records: E1, the build of the run's last game) and kept by the server since A0; older records have none and fall in the unknown window
compact record rank: the league bronze, silver, gold, platinum, diamond or legend; Ranked only, never the legend number
compact record band = d4-1: a Ranked Diamond game at star level 47-50 (Diamond 4-1), from the app version with A1; absent without the star level (game memory reading off) and in older records
compact record first: true when the player went first, false with the Coin; absent when unknown
compact record deck: the deck code the game was played with (no deck name)
compact record ocls: the opponent's class (public hero)
compact record oplays [turn, card]: opponent cards played face up, only what the player saw
compact game record v1, mull.n: the cards received for the replaced ones (the Coin left out)
compact record draws [turn, card, created]: every card that came into the hand after the mulligan; created = 1 when the card is not in the deck list (0 without a deck); turn = the player's own turn
compact record plays [turn, card, mana, created]: every card the player played; created as in draws
compact record choices[1]: discover, adapt, chooseone, dredge, excavate or choice, from the source card's mechanics
compact record choices[2]: the card that offered the choice; null when it was not visible
compact record choices[3]: the 2-8 options as shown (repeats removed by the server)
compact record choices[4]: the options picked (1-4)
compact record secs: game length in seconds, at most 6 hours
compact record turns: the game's length in player turns (game turns 2N-1 and 2N are turn N; Battlegrounds: its turns)
compact record bg.placement: the final place 1-8; Duos: the team's place 1-4
compact record bg.mmr: the rating before the game rounded down to 500, at most 10,000; absent when it was not read
compact record bg.offered: up to four base heroes seen at the hero pick in offer order (rerolled ones appended, cut at four); empty when the pick is not among them
compact record bg.picked: the base hero played
compact record bg.trinkets {o, p}: every trinket offered in the game, picks included (at most 12), and the trinkets picked (at most 4)
compact record bg.tierups [turn, tier]: the first turn the tavern reached each tier 2-7

compact record bg.comp: PoolGame.MainTribe of the final board (a tribe of at least 4 minions, amalgams counting for every tribe, else MIXED), from the app version with A1; absent for an empty board or a game recovered after a restart
arena_run record run.kind: arena or underground (task contract K1), from the app version with E1
arena_run record run.cls: the run's class
arena_run record run.wins: 0-12
arena_run record run.losses: 0-3 in Arena, 0-5 in Underground; a run is sent only when finished (12 wins or the loss limit)
arena_run record run.deck: the final deck code, optional
the server's balance patch of record.build in its line (server/pool/data/balance-patches.json, ADR 0014); null, the unknown group, without a build or below the first entry
the rank buckets of a Ranked record from record.rank and record.band: all, its league, d4-1 with the band, d4-legend for d4-1 or legend; all only without a rank
the MMR ranges of a Battlegrounds record from record.bg.mmr: all, 0-3999, 4000-5999, 6000-7999, 8000+ (the value is a multiple of 500, so it never straddles a bound); all only without mmr
the coin slices of a record from record.first: any, first (true), coin (false); any only without first
the deck list (dbf and copies) the server decodes from record.deck (deriver deck, B2); null for an unreadable code
the key of the deck list (cards and copies; card order, hero skin and format ignored, sideboard left out), deriver deck (B2); null without a readable code

the server's archetype of the player's deck from derived.cards and record.cls by the archetype dictionary from HSGuru through our API (deriver archetypes, B1, version = the dictionary's rules): a core share of at least 0.6, the best share wins, a tie goes to more games; null when unclear, for Classic and Twist and without a class; the client's oarch is never used
the server's archetype of the opponent from record.oplays and record.ocls by the same dictionary (B1): at least 3 core cards and a lead of 2; null when unclear
